ruleDecisions.decision: Use current hero and fresh OL spell3567/3568 verbatim. No extra requirement that loss be only use, response or discard, and no added prohibition against replacing existing equipment.

One card is one actual atomic owner loss batch across HE zones, not per-card iteration of a multi-card payment. HE is the ordinary owned-card scope; judgment/public-pile movements are not silently promoted to owned HE losses.

Each actual turn permits one Guying invocation for this owner even if the source generation changes. Outstanding true invocation debt survives source loss/regrant; the next actual preparation freezes and consumes the existing owner debt once. An entirely skipped turned-over turn has no preparation.

Random compensation samples actual transferable HE entities. Exact original-card return requires the original loss destination and uninterrupted movement sequence; an unavailable or permanently destroyed entity is never recreated. GeneralWeapon payment/placement restrictions and native destruction are retained.

Equipment return issues a genuine native equipment Use with a typed owning return. Muzhen equipment placement is direct placement, permits ordinary slot replacement, and retains abolished areas, slot capacities, SilverLion recovery and WoodenOx native side effects.

A genuine native finalized equipment actor replacement changes the actual equipment recipient, replacement entity and WoodenOx grain owner. The final native result is frozen from the exact use's actor-change chain, equipment-change event and actual movements, while its typed return still resumes the original Guying frame and original invocation debt.

A printed equipment entity paid as another live use's material can be returned from Processing through a distinct genuine equipment Use. The owning Guying receipt binds the exact original action, loss batch and sequence to the new native use before issuing it. No artificial Processing-to-Processing movement is recorded. Completion requires the new use's actual equipment entry/change/return facts, or its exact first terminal discard with native use-finished and once-return facts when the finalized slot has been abolished or its actual user has died; arbitrary discards and later movements cannot establish a claim.

Both Muzhen alternatives are independent once per actual Play phase. Two-card gift sources and one-equipment placement sources are HE; a paid branch completes its native children after source loss, and stops later acquisition if its owner or recipient actually dies.
Own materials remain in the owning receipt until actual payment. Foreign hand acquisition exposes opaque slots to its true chooser, and other seats cannot inspect or answer its private prompt.

excludedVariants: The older wording restricted loss to use/response/discard; that restriction is absent from current OL hero and client.
Mobile/other-product no-replacement wording is not adopted.
The x.sanguosha.com hero1119 version has different Guying/Muzhen and is not this ordinary OL identity.
